system.description:
You gain this state when you are reduced to 0 hit points and then fail a tenacity check. You don't take damage or regain hit points from states, and you also ignore minor environmental hazards, such as terrain damage.

While defeated, you do not roll initiative or take a turn in combat. If you regain hit points from a recovery, you lose this condition, and you can roll initiative and take a turn as normal in the following round.
